one_sentence_story: Csikszentmihalyi's random beeper diaries and Dietrich's 2004 neuroscience revealed that effortless 'flow' happens when clear challenge stretches trained skill just enough that your self-critical medial frontal cortex powers down and lets practiced neural circuits fly.
so_what_for_you: Engineer your own Flow Channel: turn off notifications, set ONE crystal-clear 45-minute goal with immediate feedback, and dial difficulty ~4-10% above comfort so boredom and anxiety both stay locked out.

jargon_map.plain: narrow sweet spot where high task challenge matches high trained skill with clear goals and immediate feedback
